output.summary: KEP-2915 proposes replacing the versioned kubeadm kubelet ConfigMap and RBAC names (kubelet-config-x.y) with an unversioned kubelet-config, deprecating the old format over a one-year GA deprecation period and gating the switch behind a kubeadm feature gate, UnversionedKubeletConfigMap. Status is implementable, stage beta.
output.rationale:
kubeadm writes kubelet-config-x.y using the control plane version, which is misleading given N-1 kubelet skew, and upgrades leave old ConfigMaps behind. The versioned names add redundant complexity for maintainers and users. The KEP keeps the old format for a deprecation period while introducing kubelet-config as the source of truth, with a feature gate to allow gradual adoption.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Hard switch to the new naming after a GA deprecation period without a feature gate
alternatives.why_not: The KEP states this is 'less desired'; a feature gate gives users who are slower to adapt a way to opt out during the Beta period.
The motivation describes it as faulty and redundant: the encoded version is the control plane version, not the kubelet version, and upgrades leave old objects uncleaned.

evidence.quote: Simplify the naming of the default kubelet configuration ConfigMap and related RBAC rules that kubeadm manages to the format `kubelet-config`, which does not include a version in the name.
Currently the overall design is faulty as `kubeadm init`, despite supporting a version skew with the kubelet of N-1, writes a single ConfigMap `kubelet-config-x.y`
The switch will be controlled by a new kubeadm specific feature gate (not a core one, stored in kubeadm's ClusterConfiguration) called `UnversionedKubeletConfigMap`.
Not using a feature gate has been considered, but the alternative of performing a hard switch to the new format after a GA deprecation period is less desired.
